--- create_index_interleave_quoted_schema.sql
CREATE INDEX `my-schema`.Idx ON `my-schema`.Child (Id), INTERLEAVE IN `my-schema`.Parent

--- AST
&ast.CreateIndex{
  Rparen: 53,
  Name:   &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 13,
        NameEnd: 24,
        Name:    "my-schema",
      },
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 25,
        NameEnd: 28,
        Name:    "Idx",
      },
    },
  },
  TableName: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 32,
        NameEnd: 43,
        Name:    "my-schema",
      },
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 44,
        NameEnd: 49,
        Name:    "Child",
      },
    },
  },
  Keys: []*ast.IndexKey{
    &ast.IndexKey{
      DirPos: -1,
      Lparen: -1,
      Rparen: -1,
      Name:   &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 51,
        NameEnd: 53,
        Name:    "Id",
      },
    },
  },
  InterleaveIn: &ast.InterleaveIn{
    Comma:     54,
    TableName: &ast.Path{
      Idents: []*ast.Ident{
        &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 70,
          NameEnd: 81,
          Name:    "my-schema",
        },
        &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 82,
          NameEnd: 88,
          Name:    "Parent",
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE INDEX `my-schema`.Idx ON `my-schema`.Child(Id), INTERLEAVE IN `my-schema`.Parent
